messages:
maria: FYI bringing up a customer model conversion (hf repo: user/new-small-llm). conversion failed in downstream evals after quantization.
sam: what failed exactly?
maria: After convert -> quantize -> run eval, embedding extraction crashes on shape mismatch. failing during model.embed() call.
jen: can you paste the stack?
maria: sure:
```
ValueError: embedding matrix shape mismatch: expected (512, 768) got (512, 512)
During call to load_state_dict: key 'transformer.wte' size mismatch
```
ashok: that smells like tokenizer/vocab size != embedding matrix shape or a revpin mismatch pulling an older embedding table.
maria: I dug in. Two weird things:
- the HF hub returned 206 partial responses for a few safetensors shards during download (nginx/COS CDN), convert-bot still wrote an index.json but one shard ended up truncated.
- the convert pipeline fell back to an older revision when the rev pin check hit a 403 on the index blob, so weight-key renames from the newer revision never applied.
convert-bot: started conversion job 0x7f2c id=2269876543
convert-bot: pulling files: config.json, tokenizer.json, safe1.safetensors, safe2.safetensors, special_tokens_map.json
convert-bot: downloaded safe1.safetensors (ok)
convert-bot: downloaded safe2.safetensors (HTTP 206 partial) -- wrote safe2.safetensors.part
convert-bot: warning: shard index hash mismatch, attempting revpin fallback
convert-bot: revpin fallback to revision 3a1b2c
convert-bot: applied weight-key-rename map from rev 3a1b2c (incomplete)
convert-bot: conversion completed with warnings
maria: so the on-disk combined state had a truncated shard merged into final .safetensors archive -> embedding table ended up smaller. but convert-bot still finished.
sam: why did the shard get truncated but index.json created? shouldn't we validate full checksums before merging?
jen: we do checksum verification, but the bug is subtle: our stream-writer accepted 206 with a content-length and didn't fail; checksum compared to index entry from the hub which was for the complete blob, so mismatch triggers, but we then attempted to fetch a different revision and merged partials.
tj: ops note: CDN sometimes returns 206 for range requests; some backends incorrectly send 206 for full-file requests when upstream has range headers. we need retry logic when content-length != expected and ETag mismatch.
ashok: immediate workaround: re-run convert with --force-revpin=<sha> pointing to the correct commit and with --no-stream-write to write to tmp then atomic-rename only on full checksum pass.
maria: also saw tokenizer special tokens: tokenizer.json listed bos_token but special_tokens_map.json had additional <s> mapping. Combined with weight-key rename rules that expect 'wte' dim==vocab_size produced a mismatch.
jen: action item: update convert tool to validate vocab_size == embedding.weight.shape and abort early with a clear error instead of finishing with warnings.
sam: +1. Also add a post-download sanity check: for each shard, verify sha256 and total_size matches index before any rename/merge.
jen: I'll open a PR for two fixes: strict-shard-verify and fail-fast on embedding/vocab mismatch. also add a retry path for 206 where we re-request without range and bump backoff.
convert-bot: created issue #ML-CONVERT-412: "safetensors partial download + revpin fallback leads to truncated final weights"
maria: for the customer's immediate unblock I did a manual fetch of blobs from hugginface storage (direct raw URL) with curl --retry 5 --fail --location --output safe2.safetensors and re-ran conversion with --force-revpin; succeeded.
sam: good. Can we add an integration test that simulates partial shard and ensures convert errors?
jen: yes, will add CI scenario that serves 206 for second shard and expects conversion to fail with clear message.
ashok: longer term: we should also make quantization step validate final model shapes post-quantize and before saving, since quantization can sometimes reshape embedding tables if weight-key mapping is wrong.
maria: note for benchmarks: on successful conversion + 4-bit quant, customer saw +1.5% perplexity regression vs baseline due to missing special token mapping in chat templates; so need to preserve chat templates exactly and warn if model's special token set differs from chat_template placeholders.
sam: add check: chat_template tokens subset of tokenizer.special_tokens, else fail and dump mapping suggestions.
maria: TL;DR: partial HTTP 206 -> truncated shard -> revpin fallback hid the mismatch -> converter finished with warnings -> embedding mismatch at runtime. Workarounds: re-download full blob, --force-revpin, or revert to older toolchain until PR merged.
jen: I'll post the PR link here once ready and ping infra to whitelist raw blob fetches for the customer during recovery window. :rocket:
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
